description: Post-ISO package-group plan for rebuilding the useful vmid135/vmid132-inspired AUZiX workstation state from the package repository instead of embedding it all in the live ISO.

iso_bootstrap_spine.purpose: Boot, network, SSH, partition, format, mount, refresh package repo, and install groups.

package_groups.purpose: Reach a usable graphical desktop with durable menus, terminal, file manager, network visibility, package UI, and login/session services.
validation: login as auzix from LightDM
open terminal from menu and ibar
menu categories include system, internet, graphics, office, multimedia, development
logout/login preserves menu surface

package_groups.purpose: Provide a filmable basic office/productivity layer with real launchers and CLI conversion smoke tests.
validation: lowriter --version succeeds and lowriter opens a sample document visibly
localc --version succeeds and localc opens a sample spreadsheet visibly
loimpress --version succeeds and loimpress opens a sample presentation visibly; isolated UserInstallation is allowed only when recorded in the LibreOffice package wrapper contract
lodraw --version succeeds and lodraw opens a sample drawing visibly; isolated UserInstallation is allowed only when recorded in the LibreOffice package wrapper contract
loffice --headless converts sample files without writing root-owned state into user homes
desktop entries launch through E menus only after the direct commands pass
menu labels distinguish native package launchers from Flatpak launchers where both exist

package_groups.purpose: Own Podman/rootful container service runtime and demo workloads.
validation: podman --version
podman info reports cgroupVersion v2
podman load or import from local AUZiX service archive
run AUZiX BusyBox container
run AUZiX Nginx service container and HTTP probe 8080
technical_debt: Podman currently keeps the /lib64 compatibility loader and direct-exec wrapper because patched pure /Programs ELF mode segfaulted in the builder.
Registry DNS for bkc-registry.lab.auzietek.com must be inventory/pipeline-owned before registry pulls are a hard validation gate.

package_groups.purpose: Allow selected desktop apps to arrive as Flatpaks while AUZiX native ports mature.
validation: flatpak remotes list
flatpak run shortcut works without typing app ids
menu shortcut appears after package install
known /var alias behavior is cataloged

package_groups.purpose: Make AUZiX pleasant to debug and build from itself.
validation: git clone over SSH/HTTPS with CA bundle
ldd reports AUZiX package library paths or explicitly cataloged compatibility debt
strace catches missing paths
Geany launches from menu

install_flow: Run the live preflight guard before touching disks: prove ext4 tooling, target block device visibility, repo refresh, and recovery shell access.
Install BusyBox-safe live installer preflight packages such as E2fsprogs before partition/format if they are not already in the ISO.
Refuse ext2 fallback unless explicitly selected as emergency mode.
Invoke /System/Tools/auzix-install-disk for partition, format, target-root scaffold, base package install, finalizer, fstab, boot config, and receipts.
Treat live-root copy as an explicitly labeled compatibility fallback only; release installs must be package-built from AUZiX package receipts.
While /Work/InstallTarget is still mounted, run sanity checks against the installed root; use chroot only for verification or declared post-install package groups, not as a replacement installer.
Disable/detach the ISO, hard power-cycle vmid135, and boot the real installed disk.
First boot must prove LightDM keyboard/mouse, auzix login, Enlightenment startup, terminal launch, and real package-backed menus.
After first boot, install native diagnostics and broad GNU userland only after the libc/loader compatibility lane is proven for that boot.
Install package groups based on selected role: desktop, office, container-host, flatpak, developer-tools.
Run package lifecycle hooks and generated-state triggers in dependency order.
Keep AuzixInstallerEfl and AuzixPackageManagerEfl as post-install validation targets until EFL launch/cache/session gates are clean; unattended netboot defaults to SSH/TUI.
Snapshot VM135-style demo state only after package artifacts have been rebuilt and reinstalled from the repository; live VM repairs are reference evidence, not promotion evidence.
Run group validation gates and write receipts under /System/State/install/receipts.
notes: This is the bionic rebuild map: AUZiX should recreate the rich workstation from packages after boot, not fossilize a one-off desktop root into every ISO.
